title: First Time Ordering
_note: Source of truth for this video's narration. Edit lines here, then regenerate the VTT with agent-tools/6_end-customer-help-video-creations/vtt.py. Never retype lines into chat or docs — this file is the copy.
_wps_note: Measured from the two rendered clips: 31 words / 9.01s. Re-derive if the voice or its speed setting changes.
_segment_note: The 12 scene segments are built from the user's own 15-piece hand cut of ski-demo_owner-one-item_dev_21-16-46_v8.mp4 (2026-08-21). Piece 1 was the wallpaper pre-roll; pieces 4+5 and 7+8 are CONCATENATED by stream copy, because script.json treats each of those pairs as one concept. The raw 15-piece cut is kept verbatim in segments/z_History/ — those boundaries are the specification and everything here is derived from them.

rendered.label: Intro (full screen)
rendered.line: Hi, I'm Sarah. Let me show you how to place your first order with us at Ski Demo rentals.

rendered.label: Corner transition
rendered.line: Let's get started. Here are the steps to completing your first ski rental.

scenes.label: opening-with-login
scenes.line: Hi, I'm Sarah. Let me show you how to place your first order with us at Ski Demo rentals. Let's get started. Here are the steps to completing your first ski rental. Enter your email, and we'll send you a 4 digit verification code you can enter here to sign in and create your account.

scenes.label: dashboard-new-order
scenes.line: From your dashboard, tap New Order to begin.

scenes.label: add-a-person-and-myself
scenes.line: We need to add a person to the order. You can add yourself, or invite a party member.

scenes.label: catalogue-search
scenes.line: To search for a rental item, first select a collection. The collections hold groups of like or similar items, that can come with variants, such as different sizes or colours.

scenes.label: dates-and-review
scenes.line: Select your rental starting date, and then your return date. For a one day rental, select the same day twice. You will see the start and end date, as well as the number of rental days you have chosen in the status bar. Review your order, taking a moment to check that your rental dates and the prices are correct.

scenes.label: requirements
scenes.line: Please answer some questions for us here, so we can expedite the preparation of your rental items. Then when you arrive at the store to pick up your items, you are getting the fastest possible service. Also review and agree to our rental terms and agreements.

scenes.label: checkout-pay-with-stripe
scenes.line: Review your total, then continue to payment. Take a moment to check your rental dates and the price are correct.

scenes.label: payment-card
scenes.line: Enter your credit card details to complete your rental order.

scenes.label: order-complete
scenes.line: That's it — your order is complete. Your invoice is ready, and your items will be waiting for you at the store.

scenes.label: order-history
scenes.line: You can always find your rental in your order history. And your current settings will be saved for your next visit.

scenes.label: logout-and-signed-out
scenes.line: You can now logout, using our dropdown menu in the top right corner. Thank you for renting with Ski Demo. We hope you have a great time on the slopes!

_pauses_note: A scene's `pauses` add to its spoken length in the VTT and are cut into the clip after rendering. They cost nothing and need no re-render.
_terms: A SEGMENT is a slice of demo footage with no voice. A SCENE is one segment plus its narration line — the unit this file lists. See the /ubiquitous-language skill.
_target_note: `target-length` is estimated speech + 1.2s, set 2026-08-21 to bring the finished video under 120s. The earlier rule was speech + 2.3s; at 12 scenes that totalled 140s. The pad is deliberately tight and it is affordable because 97% of this footage is a STILL PICTURE — measured, 3.1s of motion in 129.8s, with view transitions averaging 0.08s. Frames removed from inside a settled stretch cannot be seen; frames are never taken from a transition.
_merge_note: Merged 2026-08-21 from 14 scenes to 12, at the user's direction: adding a person and adding yourself are ONE concept, and picking dates and reviewing the order are ONE concept — the end user should not be taught them as two. No copy was written or discarded: each merged line is the two approved lines joined. Scene 3 in particular RESTORES the original single line that an earlier remap had split in half.
_cutmap_note: `cut-map` is the flow-log action a segment STARTS on. cut_segments.py must SNAP forward from that stamp to the first settled frame — the 2026-08-21 v3 cut was made from raw ▶ stamps with no snap, and every segment opened on the tail of the previous screen (scene 1 opened on desktop wallpaper). Snap offsets on a comparable run ranged +0.26s to +3.15s, so this is not a constant.
_retime_note: Segments were retimed by rebuilding each one FROM the v8 master (two or more spans concatenated around the removed frames), not by re-encoding the existing segment — so none of them carries a second encode generation. Scenes 1, 4 and 11 needed LENGTHENING and hold a still from their own longest settled stretch. Untrimmed copies are in segments/z_History/.
